notes: Reader reliability fix. The 0.8.6.26 ramp/double-buffer design is preserved, but a hung background edge-tts prefetch can no longer create an indefinite 30+ second silence between phrases. If the next MP3 has not finished within 9 seconds, the stuck process is killed and that same chunk is immediately streamed through edge-playback using the same Russian neural voice while the following chunk is prefetched again. Nonzero prefetch exits use the same recovery path.
